odair1.m: Oh, it's you. You with that brother of yours. Always causing trouble.

odair2.m: Hmm, maybe you could be of use to me. Do you think you could help me with a small task?
r: Tell me more about this task.
Sure, if there is anything I can gain from it.

odair3.m: I recently went in to that cave over there [points west], to check on our supplies. But apparently, the cave has been infested with rats.

odair4.m: In particular, I saw one rat that was larger than the other rats. Do you think you have what it takes to help eliminate them?
r: Sure, I'll help you so that Crossglen can use the supply cave again.
Sure, I'll help you. But only because there might be some gain for me in this.

odair5.m: I need you to get into that cave and kill the large rat, that way maybe we can stop the rat infestation in the cave and start using it as our old supply cave again.
r: On second thought, I don't think I will help you after all.

odair_complete.m: Thanks a lot for your help kid! Maybe you and that brother of yours aren't as cowardly as I thought. Here, take these coins for your help.

odair_complete2.m: Thanks a lot for your help earlier. Now we might start using that cave as our old supply cave again.

odair_continue.m: Did you kill that large rat in the cave west of here?
r: Yes, I have killed the large rat.
What was I supposed to do again?

odair_cowards.m: I didn't think so either. You and that brother of yours always were cowards.

odair.10: Odair wants me to clear the supply cave in Crossglen village of rats. In particular, I should kill the large rat and return to Odair.
odair.100: I have helped Odair clear out the rats in the supply cave in Crossglen village.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
